about: Live pages every built-in adapter is also run on, for robustness: real markup, real barriers, and pages that are already accessible, which an adapter must not make worse. Chosen for range, not endorsed; they change without notice. The verifier serves each from a copy (scripts/verify-adapters/sites.mjs): the demo sites, marked static, are recorded once; the others at most once a day.

sites.about: W3C's Before and After Demonstration: the inaccessible home page (layout tables, images of text, no headings)

aboutRealWorld: Real, popular sites the core adapters (tools/core-adapters/) are also run on: what people actually use, with markup and scripts nobody wrote for the toolkit. Chosen for range, not endorsed; they change without notice.
